name: extension-mobiletools
description: A small mobile-focused toolkit for Lime and OpenFL: runtime permissions, haptics, toasts, vibration, fullscreen, safe area, a file picker, device info, plus an hscript-based scripting and modding system, behind a single cross-platform API (Android and iOS).
releasenote: Fullscreen, safe area insets, a system file picker, and installing mods from zip files on Android and iOS.
